entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Are you really going to Shido!?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Heck yeah! I'm gonna make him[n]tell me the keyword!

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: I doubt it'll be that easy.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: He's right. We should look for[n]another way.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: But this is our one chance to actually[n]speak to him...

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: And for all we know he could be gone by[n]the time we're done wasting time here...

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: Hm, the keyword... That's for the Palace,[n]correct? Is there nothing we can do...?
